advisories.headline: Update for attention and long-session correctness
advisories.detail: 2.11.1's Turbo 27B flash verifier can produce incorrect attention on M1–M4 GPUs above 8,192 context tokens. 2.11.2 gates it to supported M5 hardware and fixes session-bank reuse and later-conversation admission. The M1–M4 defect is not evidence of an M5 failure.

advisories.headline: Re-test Turbo after updating
advisories.detail: MTPLX says one 2.9.0 Turbo fast-path flag was runtime-dead. Legacy 2.9.0 Turbo evidence is retained as history but cannot choose a fastest route.

advisories.headline: Use 2.11.2 for agent and Flash-Next fixes
advisories.detail: MTPLX 2.11.2 includes the intervening visible-answer, memory-admission, stream-diagnostics, agent-session, and Flash-Next fixes.

advisories.headline: Use 2.11.2 for memory and agent-session safety
advisories.detail: MTPLX 2.11.2 includes the later memory guard, SessionBank, postcommit, forced-tool, and warm-agent fixes.

advisories.headline: Use 2.11.2 for the current agent and decode fixes
advisories.detail: MTPLX 2.11.2 repairs warm agent turns and forced-tool session restores, and adds the audited dense-27B and Flash-Next decode work.

advisories.headline: The 2.11.0 upload was retracted
advisories.detail: MTPLX says 2.11.0 was a mis-stamped PyPI upload containing nothing beyond 2.10.2. It was retracted; update a surviving copy to 2.11.2.

workflow: Keep valid older evidence as history, but never reuse it as proof for the changed 2.11.2 runtime.
Update the app-managed engine through MTPLX's signed app updater or official DMG.
Keep swap overcommit and unmeasured context-specific operator settings disabled.
Run mtplx models --check, then repeat the same local benchmark on 2.11.2 before preferring it for TPS.

advisories.headline: 48 GiB remains outside the published support floor
